about: Landmark pairs between the scan head (skull-zanatomy) and the native head (native-head). Read by tmp/make_corrected_head_document.ts. template_point is a vertex or a point along a stroke of skull-zanatomy; target is a vertex of native-head, or a position in the frame of native-head (origin = centre of the Loomis ball, radius 0.92) where the native head has no vertex.

landmarks.name: subnasale
landmarks.note: native 24 is where the underside of the nose (stroke 17) meets the philtrum (stroke 28)

landmarks.name: upper lip front
landmarks.note: native 33 is the lower end of the philtrum stroke 28

landmarks.name: between the lips
landmarks.note: native 34 is the lower end of midline stroke 30; guessed from its height, 0.08 under 33

landmarks.name: lower lip front
landmarks.note: native 10 is where the lower lip stroke 7 starts on the midline; guessed, it may be the lip's lower edge

landmarks.name: fold under the lower lip
landmarks.note: native 18 is the lower end of midline stroke 12; guessed from its height

landmarks.name: chin bottom
landmarks.note: native 14 is the lowest point of the head

landmarks.name: inner eye corner
landmarks.note: both are the inner end of the two lid strokes (scan 117 and 118, native 18 and 19)

landmarks.name: outer eye corner
landmarks.note: both are the outer end of the two lid strokes

landmarks.name: mouth corner
landmarks.note: native 9 is where the mouth stroke 6 and the lower lip stroke 7 meet

landmarks.name: nose wing base
landmarks.note: native 2 is the lower outer end of the wing strokes 1 and 4

landmarks.name: nose wing top
landmarks.note: native 7 is the upper end of the wing stroke 4

landmarks.name: chin bottom side
landmarks.note: native 37 is the corner of the chin fills beside the midline; guessed
